lines.h1: Even when output must reach the model, most of it is repetition: repeated JSON fields, log noise, boilerplate.
lines.h2: Headroom is an open-source layer between your tools and the model. It compresses that content before the model reads it.
lines.h3: It is content-aware. JSON, code and logs each get their own compressor, so structure and the key lines survive.
lines.h4: And it is reversible. The original is cached locally, so the model can ask for the full detail when it needs it.
lines.h5: Run it as a local proxy, a library, or an M C P server. Point Claude Code at it, and your workflow stays the same.
lines.outro: Sandbox what you can. Compress what you must.
